conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md CycleMode EXPEDITED, Scope/Architecture NONE, PromotionReason NONE

conditions.condition: Workflow is at user-owned AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF after a passed implementation review
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md WorkflowState AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Handoff FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION; recovery and obligations inactive

conditions.condition: Records present: development plan and implementation review, both complete
conditions.where: .standards/docs/development/<id>.md (Status COMPLETE, DEV-001 DONE, EXPEDITED_REQUEST) and .standards/docs/reviews/<id>/implementation.md (Status COMPLETE, no material findings)

conditions.condition: No Documenter, Tester, final-review, or synchronization records exist (omitted roles)
conditions.where: built tree has only development and implementation review under .standards/docs/

conditions.condition: Small committed code change that documentation could describe
conditions.where: src/slug.js adds optional maxLength; README.md documents slugify(input) only; selfChecks confirm tests pass and README lacks maxLength
git status clean on main; three commits after install

conditions.condition: User asks only a question, no promotion/rework/sign-off request
conditions.where: prompt.utterance 'What would documentation add to this change?'

summary: The fixture builds a legal EXPEDITED brownfield cycle at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with a complete plan and implementation review, no omitted-role records, and an undocumented maxLength option that gives the Documenter something concrete to explain; check.mjs and all selfChecks pass. Checks for both assertions are necessary conditions that a correct answer-only run satisfies (no state, record, or doc changes; no sign-off; no fabricated records), and the invariants are standard and appropriate. Nothing in files, commits, or the utterance leaks the expected answer.
